title: Finance Support for Established Companies
summary: FP&A, consolidation, IFRS and Ind AS reporting, controls and audit support for multi-entity and multi-country businesses.
metaDescription: FP&A, consolidation, IFRS and Ind AS reporting, internal audit and controls for established companies with multiple entities in India and the GCC.
heroHeading: Finance leadership and capacity, without the full-time overhead.
heroIntro: Established companies bring us in for planning, reporting and controls: rolling forecasts, group consolidation, IFRS and Ind AS reporting and risk-based internal audit.
challengesHeading: Where established companies need extra capacity

challenges.title: Multiple entities
challenges.text: Intercompany balances, currencies and reporting calendars that do not line up.

challenges.title: Reporting frameworks
challenges.text: Ind AS, IFRS and group reporting needs beyond local statutory accounts.

challenges.title: Controls and assurance
challenges.text: Documented processes, risk-based internal audit and fewer audit surprises.

howWeHelp.title: Planning and forecasting
howWeHelp.text: Rolling forecasts and scenarios, with lender and investor reporting packs.

howWeHelp.title: Group reporting
howWeHelp.text: Consolidation with intercompany eliminations and currency translation.

howWeHelp.title: Frameworks
howWeHelp.text: Ind AS and IFRS statements, and conversion projects.

howWeHelp.title: Controls
howWeHelp.text: Internal audit, SOP review and anomaly checks.

faqs.q: Can you work alongside our in-house team?
faqs.a: Yes. Many established clients use us for capacity, specialist reporting or independent review while their team keeps day-to-day ownership.
